purpose: Cost and infrastructure calibration, not held-out quality qualification
sampling: provider defaults; no cross-provider seed equivalence
ordering: serial, provider then suite then listed arm; not randomized
billingLimitNote: Between-trial stop, not a provider billing hard cap. Current in-flight usage may be unknown.
exclusions: No dropped failures or automatic retries. Previously used tasks are development data. No benchmark superiority or narrow noninferiority inference.
